# Vendored Ascii Box client

`box-client` is the clean Git source of `nessalabs/asciibox-client-rs` at
`69ca3c913986602ae13a0500157390ac118f599a` (`main`, synced 2026-09-08 UTC), under its included MIT license.
It is vendored so SDK consumers do not need a sibling checkout.

There are no local source patches. Upstream now includes the HTTP PUT file-write
correction; the earlier patch and live reports remain historical evidence in
`docs/evidence/README.md` and `docs/evidence/box-client-file-write.patch`.
No uncommitted changes from the shared development checkout are included.
